title: Order Status Replies
seo: Automatic order status and tracking replies
meta: Customers get order and delivery updates pulled from your store, with no agent needed. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Order status replies pulled from your own system
overview: Where is my order is the most common question in online retail. We connect a reply helper to your store and shipping data so it can look up the order, read the tracking status and answer in friendly words. The customer verifies with their order number and email first. If the parcel is late or lost, the case moves to your team with every detail attached.

list: Proactive message when a parcel stalls

faq: Shopify and WooCommerce are the most common, and we also work with BigCommerce and custom stores that expose order data. Tell us your platform and shipping tool in the order form.
How does it confirm who is asking?
It asks for the order number and the email used at checkout, and only shares status with a match. It never reveals other orders or full addresses.
What if the tracking shows nothing?
It tells the customer honestly that the carrier has not updated yet, gives the last known step and offers a handoff to your team if it is past your normal window.
Can it change or cancel orders?
No. This service only reads status. Changes, cancellations and refunds stay with your team, so nothing can be altered by a chat message.
